LESSON: SWADAQAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Swadaqah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Swadaqah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What acts of swadaqah do Muslims perform?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify forms of swadaqah for character development
2. demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards
3. appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

• Then do Try this.

▸ Skill 3: appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify forms of swadaqah for character development
• Model 2: demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards
• Model 3: appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify forms of swadaqah for character development
2. Practise: demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards
3. Practise: appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Swadaqah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What acts of swadaqah do Muslims perform?
2. What are the benefits of practising swadaqah?

• demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards
